stock_scope: Untrimmed C15 finite-wall members and frame-side socket stock. Overlaps have not been subtracted; no completed assembly net-mass claim. Old visible drive proxies are excluded and replaced by complete module budgets. C14 component reserves are not added again.

high_load_rotary.basis: RV-320E reducer alone is 44.3 kg. Motor, brake, drive, housing, mounts and thermal interfaces are explicit unverified additions. Gearbox rated 3136 Nm is not upgraded by mass allowance.

secondary_rotary.basis: CSG65 alone 20.9 kg, plus motor/brake/drive/mounts. Which axes need a larger unit remains open.

upper_arm_rotary.basis: CSG65 scale; complete drive is not selected or thermally qualified.

elbow_rotary.basis: Provisional complete intermediate joint, requires its own continuous torque/source.

wrist_rotary.basis: AK80-64 is a size calibration, not a demonstrated wrist selection for the load cases.

hand_assembly.basis: Complete hand mechanisms, drives, local supports, feedback and contact surfaces; finger topology not frozen.

waist_rotary.basis: Three-axis envelope allocation, not an assigned SI joint order or actual SKU.

foot_lock.basis: Four independent segment-lock/withdrawal mechanisms and feedback, capacity unverified.

high_force_electric_linear.basis: Motor/reduction/roller screw/rod/guides/end mounts/brake/drive. Force, fatigue, retracted length and thermal capability remain red-line unknown.

hydraulic_cylinder_assembly.basis: HMI63/28 dry 13.9 kg or HMI80/36 dry 24.9 kg at 200mm stroke. Rod-end, two mounts, feedback and local fittings included as unverified additions; wet central system separate.

eha_complete.basis: Cylinder plus local motor/pump/drive/valve/compensation/fluid/mounts. No equivalent compact complete product verified; cannot release it as a yellow-only custom module.

central_motor_pump.basis: Motor/pump/drive/support assembly sized later from simultaneous flow and pressure, no SKU selected.

central_wet_system.basis: Fluid/tank or compensation/hoses/fittings, no dry-cylinder shortcut.

distributed_wet_connections.basis: EHA local fluid is counted within each complete unit; only external fill/service connections here.

energy_system.basis: 8-12kWh packaging target. Victron 2.56kWh/19kg calibrates energy density; HV cells, BMS, contactors/precharge/protection/regeneration enclosure not selected. No forbidden series connection is proposed.

thermal_system.basis: Heat exchangers/pumps/fans/ducts/coolant/mounts, not grille decoration or demonstrated heat removal.

compute_sensing.basis: Compute/storage/network/cameras/IMU/force feedback/DC conversion, no compute board selected.

harness_and_mounts.basis: Power/data harnesses/connectors/clamps and service slack; hydraulic fluid/hoses counted elsewhere.

assembly_fasteners_and_covers.basis: Unmodelled fastening/mount/guard reserve, replace with actual rows without duplication.

linear_electric.efficiency_scope: Derived from assumed link 0.85, screw 0.85, reduction 0.90, motor 0.85/0.90/0.96 and inverter 0.94/0.96/0.98. A shaft-to-bus efficiency exceeding the component product is forbidden. These are sizing assumptions, not continuous hardware qualifications.

load_case_scope: Leg lever/dynamic factor/shaft speed/concurrence are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not FK-derived or validated postures. Gravity/support pitch sizing only, not total joint torque: add axis-specific articulated inertia, horizontal acceleration, disturbance, off-axis loads, contact feasibility and actual lever sweeps before release. Mass index low/nominal/high is evaluated separately for every case.

energy.voltage_scope: Comparison only. Full-charge/minimum voltage, drive windows and complete HV pack are not selected.

thermal.intake_scope: Provisional area estimate from previous slot sampling; not certified net aperture, fan/core pressure-drop capability or CFD.

separate_structural_pressure_case_scope: User-requested upper-body pressure test demand, not payload rating. No force-transfer or new-foot strength approval from this budget.
